title: `test-adapters` target depends on adapter directories that exist only as untracked files
what: `test-adapters` was in `all-tests`, but it depends on adapter directories that exist only as untracked files on this machine. It was removed from `all-tests` (the target stays defined).
why: Fresh-clone verification (DECISIONS.md): fix made to get `make setup` + `npm install` + `make all-tests test-python test-git test-fuzz` to pass.
impact: `make all-tests` does not run adapter tests. Adapter tests must be run individually.
workaround: Run adapter test targets individually (`test-typescript`, `test-bazel`, etc.).
